name: Local Git
summary: Preview: inspect status, diffs and history in a disposable local repository.
description: Unpublished qualification preview, not project-ready. Pinned upstream exposes both reads and mutations. Explicit saved Ask/Off policy and a real filesystem fence are required; read-only annotations are not authorization.
about: Qualification uses an isolated hash-locked dependency environment, not this top-level-only uvx reference. See DEVELOPER_LOCAL_GIT_QUALIFICATION.md for exact runtime, schema and evidence.
Local source can enter model context. No account or remote operation is qualified. Do not expose owner repositories, Git configuration or credentials.

fields.label: Disposable repository
fields.tip: An owned disposable fixture only. An absolute path does not grant a Linux mount.

guide: Preview only: do not install in production or infer that these instructions override server readOnlyHint defaults.
Resolve and hash-lock all dependencies in a dedicated environment; use the reviewed absolute interpreter and package bytes, not an ambient uvx cache.

Before any feature call save all eight read tools as Ask and git_add, git_commit, git_reset, git_create_branch, git_checkout and git_merge as Off; readback the persisted effective policy for all fourteen registered tools.
Keep unknown tools Off. Use isolated HOME/config, disable optional Git locks, external diff, textconv, filters, fsmonitor, credential helpers and hooks; never trust repository config as inert data.
Only use a synthetic repository in the existing MCP home fence. No broad host mount, owner repository, provider authorization or remote operations.
Disconnect after use. Direct registered-tool tests do not qualify full chat approvals, cancellation or project authority.
